text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Redwood API /v1/generate error rate spike detected. 5xx rate 18% over last 2m, latency p95 2.1s. Affected region: us-west-2. Paging oncall Priya K. thread_ts=1851234567
Priya K: Acked. I'm oncall. Pulling logs and checking active rollouts. @Samir can you surface any customer tickets?
Samir (support): pulling Zendesk for last 30m. Already seeing a handful of tickets complaining about timeouts when generating embeddings. Ticket examples linked: https://redwood.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/2384,2385
Marcus L: I see redis KV errors in the serving layer and an increase in GPU OOMs in pool dedicated-3. Rolling OOMs correlate with model-quantized:v2 usage.
Priya K: Good catch. Quick impact assessment: which customers on Dedicated vs Hosted? Samir?
Samir (support): quick list: 3 large hosted tenants (prod), 2 dedicated customers on dedicated-3 (internal ids D-77, D-91). Affected customers reported generation timeouts and partial tokens.
Jenna P: Flags for comms: likely degraded quality + latency. Suggest Statuspage incident with "degraded performance" and Zendesk macro to impacted customers.
Priya K: Drafting initial statuspage update below, please +1 or edit:
Priya K: "We are investigating increased error rates and latency for text generation in the US-West region. Some requests may fail or take longer than expected. Engineers are actively triaging; we will provide updates every 30 minutes. If you experience an outage impacting production, reply to your support ticket for prioritized handling."
Marcus L: Triaging plan I: 1) scale up serving pool dedicated-3 by +2 nodes, 2) temporarily throttle heavy model variant quantized:v2, 3) revert recent kernel optimization if regression confirmed.
Priya K: Doing scale action now. deploy-bot: run autoscale add --pool dedicated-3 --count 2
deploy-bot: Triggered autoscale job 98321, nodes provisioning. ETA ~2m.
Priya K: While nodes come up, let's prepare customer-facing messages. Samir, please use this Zendesk reply macro for hosted customers (short):
Samir (support): Copying macro draft:
```
Hi <Customer name>,\n\nThanks for flagging this. We're currently investigating increased errors and latency for text generation in US-West. Our engineers are actively working on mitigation. We expect a follow-up within 30 minutes. If this is blocking, reply and we'll escalate.\n\nStatus updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1851234567
Apologies for the inconvenience,
Redwood Support
```
Samir (support): Also adding Intercom quick note for in-app banners: "Experiencing delays or errors in text generation in US-West. Full details and updates on Status page."
Priya K: Internal exec note (for ops-leads + PMs). Use this template and paste into #ops-briefing:
```
Short summary: Elevated error rate and latency for text generation in us-west impacting hosted customers and two Dedicated pools.\nCurrent impact: ~18% 5xx, p95 latency up from 400ms -> 2.1s. Some customers experiencing timeouts.\nAction taken: Autoscaling pool, throttling quantized:v2 variants, engineering triage.\nETA: first mitigations in progress; full recovery unknown.\nNext update: in 30m or on change.\n```
Marcus L: New logs while scaling:
```
[2026-07-18T14:02:11Z] serving: alloc_failed: kernel_launch_failed: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
[2026-07-18T14:02:26Z] kv-cache: retrying get prefix, latency spike
```
Marcus L: Looks like packing density of sessions is causing OOMs. I'm going to temporarily prevent placement on nodes with older drivers and move some sessions to new nodes when available.
Priya K: Good. Samir, please start flagging high-value customers for direct outreach (Slack/email). List them here when ready.
Samir (support): Flagging: Acme Inc (acct A-100), FlowCommerce (acct F-22). Leaving a proactive note to their account reps now.
Priya K: STATUSPAGE UPDATE (post now):
Priya K: "Investigating — Elevated error rates and increased latency for the Redwood text generation API in US-West. Some requests may fail or take longer than expected. Engineers are actively investigating. We will provide updates every 30 minutes. Affected: hosted API and select dedicated pools."
Samir (support): Posted status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1851234567 (incident created)
Priya K: CUSTOMER NOTIFICATION (email template for dedicated customers):
Samir (support): Draft email:
Subject: Service degradation in US-West for text generation
Body:
"Hi <Customer Team>,

We wanted to let you know we're investigating degraded performance and intermittent errors against the text generation API in US-West. Our engineering team is actively working on mitigation steps, including scaling capacity and routing traffic to healthy nodes.

Impact: Increased error rate and higher latency for some requests.
Temporary mitigations: Autoscaling of serving pool; temporary throttling of a heavy model variant.
Estimated next update: 30 minutes. We will follow up with a technical postmortem once resolved.

If you need immediate support or want us to move workloads to another region, reply and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Redwood Support & SRE
"
Priya K: Meanwhile, follow runbook checklist for memory OOMs. Marcus, run these commands and paste outputs:
Marcus L: Running minimal checks:
```
# check GPU memory allocations
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv
# list serving processes by mem
ps aux --sort=-rss | head -n 20 | grep serve
# tail recent crash logs
journalctl -u redwood-serving -n 200
```
Marcus L: Results: major processes pegging single GPUs; some processes crashed with cudaAlloc errors. Removing some sessions freed memory.
Priya K: Mitigation step 1 done? scale completed and some jobs moved?
deploy-bot: Autoscale completed, nodes added and joined. Job 98321: success.
Marcus L: After scale, 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 9% within 4m. p95 latency back to 900ms. Still above baseline. I'm executing throttle on quantized:v2 variants now.
Priya K: Command to throttle (internal):
```
redwood route update --model quantized:v2 --max-qps 50 --region us-west-2
```
Marcus L: Throttle applied. Observing further drop to 4% 5xx.
Samir (support): Updating tickets with status. Using macro: "Mitigations applied: scaled pool + throttled heavy variant. Monitoring for recovery."
Jenna P: Important: check A/B canaries for quality regressions when throttling. We might be falling back to lower-quality variants; surface any production impact.
Priya K: Good point. Marcus, can you list which customers were routed to fallback variants?
Marcus L: Rough mapping: Acme Inc had fallback to base-1.3; FlowCommerce still on quantized:v2 but with lower QPS. I'll push per-tenant routing logs to the thread.
Marcus L: logs snippet:
```
[2026-07-18T14:12:31Z] routing: tenant=A-100 route changed quantized:v2 -> base-1.3 fallback=true
[2026-07-18T14:12:52Z] routing: tenant=F-22 QPS capped 30 (was 200)
```
Priya K: Customer comm update for Acme (short):
```
Hi Acme team,

We applied a temporary routing change to use a compatible model variant to reduce errors. You may notice slight changes in output characteristics. We can revert or route to a different region on request.

If you want us to migrate your traffic off us-west while we stabilize, say the word and we'll prioritize.

— Redwood SRE
```
Samir (support): Sent proactive Slack to account reps and left ticket notes.
Ryan O (oncall): Heads-up, I'm 30m into shift overlap for handoff. Anything I should pick up?
Priya K: Thanks Ryan. Please watch for recurrence after autoscale cools. If error rate creeps back above 10% escalate to page. Handoff notes for you: pool dedicated-3 had OOMs, scaled +2 nodes, throttled quantized:v2, statuspage up, key customers notified (Acme, FlowCommerce).
Ryan O (oncall): Got it. I'll monitor and run the same checklist if it recurs.
Priya K: Postmortem notes to capture later: timeline of kernel change, model variant resource usage, autoscale timing, and customer impact + tickets. Assigning owners: Marcus -> root cause candidate and logs; Samir -> customer timeline and tickets; Jenna -> communication & postmortem writeup.
Jenna P: I'll draft the postmortem with sections: Summary, Impact, Timeline, Root Cause Hypothesis, Mitigations, Action Items. ETA first draft in 48h.
Samir (support): Closing loop: tickets updated; customers acknowledged proactive messages. No escalations to legal/ops so far.
Priya K: Closing update before I hand off: system stabilized, error rate 2%, p95 latency ~420ms, monitoring for 1h. Posting resolution to status page in 30m if stable. Thanks all. :pray:
incident-bot: NOTE: incident has been updated to status=investigating -> monitoring by Priya K. Next update scheduled at +30m.
Priya K: Resolved note ready for status page (post if stable):
"Resolved — The elevated error rates and increased latency for text generation in US-West have been mitigated. Root cause under investigation; temporary mitigations (autoscaling and throttling of a model variant) were applied to restore service. We will publish a technical postmortem when available."
Ryan O (oncall): Acknowledged and taking over monitoring. Handoff complete.
Priya K: Thanks team. After action: add an automatic alert when OOMs > 3 in 2m and a playbook link in the pager to this runbook.
Marcus L: Will add. ETA configuration push 1h.
Samir (support): Saving macros used in thread to support library: zendesk/incident-degraded-template, intercom/in-app-banner-degraded.
Priya K: End of thread.
